reading.title: How to Be a Good Learner
reading.purpose: Learn ways to ask, answer, and share what you know.
paras: A good learner asks a question. A question helps you find out more. When someone gives an answer, listen well.
You can describe what you see. You can explain how you know. Share your idea. Then remember it for next time.

qs.q: In this reading, an answer is
choices: what you say when someone asks.
qs.why: When someone asks a question, the answer is what you say back.

qs.q: What helps you find out more?
qs.why: The reading says a question helps you find out more.

qs.q: Which word tells you to say how you know something?
qs.why: The reading says you can explain how you know.
